methodology: Exact unique ADREC ID-to-dashboard project-name crosswalk; residential full-share sale rows only. Individual transaction identifiers are not returned by the endpoint; stable hashes cover normalized source rows and duplicate ordinal. Price per square foot is computed only from full-share sale price / sold area. This is a 2019 onward endpoint window, not complete lifetime history. Previously retained rows are reconciled as a multiset using date, price, area, property type/layout, district/community, registration, sequence and sold share. This preserves identical-row multiplicity while treating full-row hash changes outside those transaction dimensions as source revisions rather than new sales.
